overview: 快照capture／素材副本與pin／payload-index發布／復原生命週期完整候選；保留已驗收S1。

architecture.purpose: M07 publishes durable recoverable captured versions independently of formal-save baseline, and restores a verified snapshot as a new unsaved document. Preserve accepted S1 scheduling/state rules exactly.
architecture.hexagonal: Timer/UI/Test → closed recovery input commands → DispatchHost RecoveryOwner → HOST RecoveryStore orchestration → existing WORK recovery_state policy. Output ports: M04 immutable capture/restore seam, M05 pin/export/import/root seam, new RecoveryStoragePort, existing FileCommitPort for index. Native adapter owns handles/immutable files; domain owns no IO/timer.
architecture.dependencies: RecoveryOwner → M04 single DocumentOwner, not another content registry. RecoveryOwner → M05 MaterialOwner. HOST → Ports abstractions; WindowsRecoveryStorage implements RecoveryStoragePort. M04/M05 cannot call recovery UI; no cycles via callbacks under locks.

ownership.M07: Per-project/session policy state, attempt identity/phase, immutable payload/bundle manifests and recovery index. History UI is derived, not retention authority.
ownership.M04: Only active document session/content/history/baselines and trusted immutable capture; IO-health denies unsafe capture/install.
ownership.M05: Catalog/version identities, durable Held pins and five-kind root manifests; no M07 policy ACK authority.
ownership.storage adapter: Verified immutable payload/material copies and safe recovery-store identity. IO adapter retains private index journal ownership.
ownership.UI: list/preview/confirm only; cannot declare Published or provide trusted payload/roots.

architecture.mutation: Capture is read-only under document owner stable boundary. Snapshot storage changes under M07 attempt/index lease. Restore installs only through M04 new-unsaved-session seam, not setters/reconstruction of current dirty session.
architecture.transactions: Immutable material copies and payload → atomic index CAS publication → durable M05 root transfer → M07 Published +M04 recovery ACK. These are separate transactions bridged by durable Held pins; no multi-file atomicity claim.
architecture.scope: Automatic 60s checks, manual check, payload/material/index publication, restart enumeration, verified restore, mark processed/hide-history lifecycle. Physical deletion, retention expiry, cross-restart Undo, repair and complete product release excluded; requirements preserved as separate tasks.
forbidden: snapshot success before all durable evidence
M07 owns second M04 session registry
unverified original path used as restore destination

capture_fingerprint.scheduler: Use monotonic elapsed milliseconds per runtime session; no accumulated wall-clock jump catch-up. One check event at most per60000ms according to existing S1. Timer wakes runtime, no domain OS timer. TimeRegressed is classified clock error; do not reset successful baseline. Session close cancels future events; in-flight evidence still reconciles.
capture_fingerprint.stable_capture: M04 capture_recovery(context,expected_generation) returns ImmutableCapture {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_uuid,generation,revision,format,canonical_payload,semantic_profile,semantic_digest,asset_pairs,binding_projection,legacy_alias_mapping}. Under owner lock copy one stable S1 capture plus complete resolver evidence; release lock before IO. Mutating/Applying/WriteInFlight/RecoveryBlocked => defer/DependencyNotReady, no partial capture.
capture_fingerprint.fingerprint: SGA-RECOVERY-FP-v1 bytes = compact UTF8 JSON ["SGA-RECOVERY-FP-v1",format,semantic_profile,semantic_digest,sorted [[asset_id,digest]],sorted [[binding_id,target_id_or_null,state]]]. IDs/strings escaped by SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1 JSON string policy, literal Unicode, no BOM/newline. SHA256 lowercase. Includes immutable material versions; does not hash selection/time/path. Duplicate IDs/conflicting pair policy must pass adopted M04/M05 validation first.
capture_fingerprint.baseline_mapping: S1 successful_fingerprint stores RECOVERY-FP hash; CapturedAttempt.asset_manifest_digest hashes compact JSON sorted pair array; captured_fingerprint is immutable attempt fingerprint. M04 acknowledge_recovery_save receives captured revision +M04 content semantic digest, not RECOVERY-FP or payload raw SHA. M07 fingerprint and M04 recovery baseline are separate projections; formal baseline untouched.
capture_fingerprint.sequence: Trusted current fingerprint from stable owner projection → S1 Check. RequestCapture queues one capture job. Obtain complete immutable validated capture and register existing S1 BeginAttempt BEFORE pin/copy; CapturedAttempt authenticates captured data, not publication. Then M05 resolve+Recovery pin exact pairs and revalidate owner identity. Known pin/setup/capture-change failure completes that registered attempt Failed with baseline unchanged and Held evidence retained; never mix versions. If capture temporarily unavailable before BeginAttempt, keep the single capture_requested job pending and service it on later runtime ticks (S1 Check WaitInFlight creates no duplicate); Close cancels it via existing S1. No hidden reset/cancel API. One attempt active per session.
capture_fingerprint.newer_edit: After stable capture/pin, immutable bundle publication can continue while live revision advances through normal owner operations unless health guard requires defer. Completion ACK uses old captured revision; live newer content remains pending for next check. Never suppress newer change by using current digest in completion.
capture_fingerprint.no_assets: Only complete projector-proven empty manifest may skip blob copying; unknown material dependency is an error, never [] fallback.
capture_fingerprint.attempt: Server lowerhex32 attempt_id minted before pin; binds project/document/session/generation/capture fingerprint. M07 tracks phase Capture|Pinned|Copying|PayloadDurable|IndexCommitted|RootsTransferred|Acknowledged|Deferred|RecoveryBlocked. S1 state not extended; application phase registry holds evidence separately.

schema_storage.layout: App-private recovery root (trusted environment capability), projects/<project_uuid>/index.v1.json; objects/<sha256>.payload and objects/<sha256>.asset in same project recovery store. Original project path only display metadata, never authority. All directory components server-derived safe IDs; adapter verifies handle identity and rejects aliases/reparse escape.
schema_storage.payload: UTF8 compact JSON object fixed field order: schema="SGA-RECOVERY-PAYLOAD-v1", project_uuid,document_uuid,source_session_uuid,owner_generation,revision,format,semantic_profile,semantic_digest,recovery_fingerprint,canonical_payload_base64,asset_manifest,bindings,legacy_alias_mapping. Base64 RFC4648 standard padding, no whitespace; strict decoded-size check. Original exact internal canonical payload carried losslessly; never UI XML/JSON reparse replacing original capture.
schema_storage.asset_manifest: sorted [{asset_id,digest,size_bytes,recovery_object_digest}] by asset_id UTF8/digest; recovery_object_digest must equal exact SHA256 material bytes. Dedup copy by digest but retain all identity pairs. All captured versions, including necessary unsaved/imported versions, copied and durably verified before payload publication.
schema_storage.index: {schema,project_uuid,generation:u64,entries:Entry[],operations:Operation[]}; entries sorted snapshot_id; entry {snapshot_id,source_document_uuid,source_session_uuid,owner_generation,captured_revision,format,semantic_profile,semantic_digest,recovery_fingerprint,payload_digest,payload_size,asset_manifest_digest,asset_total_bytes,pin_id,state:Unprocessed|Processed,history_visible:bool,created_at_display}. Processing/hiding cannot remove entry or roots. Initial generation0, effective transition checked+1. Operation IDs persisted for replay.
schema_storage.validation: Reject raw duplicate/unknown fields, wrong types, malformed IDs/digests, floats for integer fields, UTF8 BOM, wrong schema/project, duplicate snapshot IDs, generation overflow, malformed base64. Validate all exact manifest/context/digests before user preview/restore; do not execute payload props/scripts/links. No arbitrary archive extraction.
schema_storage.limit_rules: Inclusive; raw UTF8 byte counts before typed parse; base64 encoded length checked before allocating decode and decoded length verified. Request arrays count before dedup; bundle bytes sum unique blob digests checked with overflow-safe u64. Output counting writer checks index/payload caps before IO. Capacity fails without eviction/deleting older snapshots; bounds proposed for Owner.
schema_storage.durability: Immutable file receipt requires full bytes hash, flush, durable publication and verified existing object on dedup. Existing corrupt object never overwritten. Payload/index and material catalog are distinct digest domains. Recovery root/list can survive original project relocation because bundle is self-contained; restore still requires authorized destination project.

ports.RecoveryStoragePort: bind_recovery_root(trusted_app_storage_capability,project_uuid) -> RecoveryStoreHandle; handle.publish_immutable(kind:Payload|Asset,expected_digest,bytes) -> ObjectReceipt; handle.read_verified(kind,digest,max_bytes) -> VerifiedBytes; handle.index_target() -> authorized opaque path for FileCommitPort; handle.inspect_identity() -> StoreIdentity. No delete/repair/execute methods.
ports.ObjectReceipt: {store_identity,kind,digest,size_bytes,Created|VerifiedExisting}; caller verifies exact digest/size and expected safe store. Native Windows11 x64 adapter; unsupported platform explicit. No raw arbitrary user path API.
ports.M04_capture_port: capture_recovery(context) -> ImmutableCapture; validate_recovery_capture(identity) -> Current|Changed|Unavailable; acknowledge_recovery_capture(identity,verified_publication) -> Acked|Deferred. Existing S1 capture/ack methods reused behind application seam, not changed.
ports.M04_restore_port: prepare_recovered_document(trusted_destination,verified_candidate,operation_id) -> RestorePlan; install_recovered_document(plan,current_destination_generation,verified_pin) -> NewUnsavedSession|InstalledRetentionDeferred. Never overwrite current active document automatically; request leave confirmation first if replacement navigation needed.
ports.M05_extension_export: read_pinned_version(verified_pin,asset_id,digest,max_bytes) -> verified immutable bytes; requires native safe handle/hash/size. MaterialStorePort StoreHandle gains read_verified_blob(digest,expected_size,max_bytes), only callable by owner under valid pin. Original M05 proposal had verify-only; this is explicit new pending Port amendment, not assumed existing.
ports.M05_extension_restore: import_recovery_versions(trusted_destination,verified_material_bundle,operation_id) -> ImportedPinnedManifest; publish all immutable blobs then single catalog index publishes versions+Recovery/Candidate pin+operation. Preserve asset IDs/digests; conflicting identity/legacy alias refuses before document install. Failed import may leave retained orphan blobs; no partial document state.
ports.M05_root_port: Existing proposed transfer pin → authoritative RecoverySnapshots root manifest plus publication proof. Recovery entry/payload/material reference set must match exact pin; unavailable/stale provider cannot mark Published. startup observed unverified index => Unknown.
ports.clock: Runtime monotonic elapsed input adapter, fake in tests; no injectable clock into WORK type changes. UTC timestamp display only.
ports.FileCommit_reuse: Index exclusive lease read_current/replace_checked raw expected digest; verify all receipt fields. Adapter private journal untouched; acquire already performs startup journal inspection and may create lock sidecar.

publication: Authorize stable owner/capture and bind recovery store; receive durable M05 Recovery pin before copying materials. Do not hold document/catalog locks during blob IO.
Copy every unique pinned material into recovery store; verify each ObjectReceipt and all captured material identity pairs. Publish exact payload only after all copies durable.

Acquire recovery index FileCommit lease; strict read/schema, verify operation replay; append entry Unprocessed and operation record; replace_checked prior raw digest. Verify target_path, previous_digest, committed_digest hash index bytes and nonempty transaction_id.

Transfer M05 Held pin to RecoverySnapshots root using authenticated proof {snapshot_id,capture identity,payload receipt,all material receipts,index receipt,asset manifest digest}. No assumption that index+catalog commit atomically.

Only after transfer receipt verifies feed S1 Complete Published and M04 captured recovery ACK. If owner closed, S1 IgnoreClosedCompletion; durable entry/root retained; no ACK to new session. Formal-save baseline never changes.

failure_table.before_index_commit: No visible snapshot entry; S1 Failed only after known failure terminal; successful baseline unchanged; durable Held/orphan objects retained until safe explicit reconciliation.
failure_table.index_uncertain: RecoveryBlocked; retain attempt+pin+all receipts. Never send Failed implying index unchanged; next writes blocked until verified evidence/recovery.
failure_table.index_committed_root_transfer_failed: PublishedRetentionDeferred; index entry visible as pending integrity/retention proof, not recoverable-ready. Held retained, no S1 Published or M04 ACK; explicit reconcile uses same immutable proof, no payload/index rewrite.
failure_table.roots_transferred_ack_failed: PublishedAckDeferred; durable snapshot available, baseline not claimed advanced until matching completion accepted. Replay completion only same attempt/current original owner; no forced reconstruction.
failure_table.response_lost: Read same operation record and validate receipts; no duplicate entry or second ACK.
failure_table.newer_revision: Complete old captured fingerprint; live newer remains dirty/pending; formal baseline unchanged.

transactions_lifecycle.restart: Read trusted project recovery index through existing IO acquire journal checks; verify payload and all asset objects on demand before Ready/restore. No raw directory guessing as index authority. Reconcile only exact committed index entry+pin proofs from M05; missing proof => PendingVerification/Unknown root, retain. Old session S1 state not reconstructed to fake ACK; new session baseline starts independently.
restore: User selects snapshot_id from authorized index and explicit destination project; verify safe index/payload/material receipts, schema/profile and complete binding/ref projection. Unsupported codec/projector => DependencyNotReady; no raw fallback.

Create preview plan containing source snapshot fingerprint, destination binding/generation, source index generation, exact material identities and content semantic digest. TTL60seconds monotonic, max32plans/runtime, no eviction; no content mutation during preview.

On confirm revalidate source/destination/TTL/IO-health and operation replay; M05 imports verified bundle into destination preserving IDs/version digests and returns durable pin. Never use original path metadata to overwrite file.

M04 installs a new document/session identity, content at initial revision0, no formal baseline, empty Undo/Redo (not cross-restart history). Source identity kept metadata only; content canonical schema IDs preserved unless format requires a new explicit approved remap. New document dirty/unsaved; recovery baseline None until its own snapshot. No original formal file write.

Publish destination live roots and transfer pin. If install committed but transfer fails: InstalledRetentionDeferred, keep pin and show installed unsaved doc. Mark source Processed only after verified install receipt; if mark fails RestoreInstalledMarkDeferred with source Unprocessed retained. No rollback of installed document claim.
transactions_lifecycle.lifecycle: mark_processed and hide_history are independent metadata CAS operations with operation replay; neither removes index entry/assets/roots or ACKs baselines. Formal save never discards snapshots. Session close revokes scheduler and restore plans; in-flight completion retains durable proofs for reconciliation, no force-cancel write. Project switch never adopts old completion into replacement owner.
transactions_lifecycle.cleanup: No retention expiry, quota eviction, physical file deletion or repair in this slice. Snapshot count/storage warning shown; exhausted capacity blocks new publication and retains prior valid data. Later deletion needs dedicated native fence and root transaction approval.
transactions_lifecycle.locking: One M07 attempt/session. Catalog pin lease released before recovery index IO. No root/provider callback under index lease; transfer after index lease released. Replay/late completion identity includes project/doc/session/generation/attempt, never just snapshot label.

errors.shape: RecoveryError {code,stage,path?,reason,attempt_id?,operation_id?,details}; tagged success/error/deferred variants mutually exclusive.
errors.precedence: caller/role/project → closed DTO raw size/type → owner/session/generation/health → operation replay → capture/codec/profile validation → pin/material proof → bounds/objects → index journal/CAS/receipt → root transfer → policy and recovery ACK. Restore validates all source bytes before destination catalog mutation. No IO after first denied precondition.
errors.details: Keep exact underlying CommitError and MaterialError variants/fields; Storage stage/path/reason and RecoveryRequired journal/old/new evidence retained in authorized diagnostics. JSON pointer paths for payload/index, object paths replaced with opaque digest for unprivileged UI. No raw content leaked.
errors.retry: S1 Failed means known publication failure and baseline unchanged; next60s check retries with new attempt after old terminal classification. Uncertain/committed-deferred attempts reconcile exact prior proof before any new write, no blind retry. No automatic pin expiration or snapshot deletion.
errors.S1_mapping: Published only trusted completed all-durable pipeline. Failed only known terminal unsuccessful pipeline; app deferred phases are not new S1 enum variants. IgnoreClosedCompletion respected, never manually reset successful fingerprint/attempt to force progress.

ui.ACL: Main Editor only; Viewer cannot invoke any recovery command. Timer is trusted runtime input, not UI callback granting Published. IDs ASCII1..128; expected generations u64; deny unknown DTO fields. No filesystem path/payload/receipt/complete flag accepted from UI.
ui.states: List PendingVerification|Ready|RetentionDeferred|Blocked plus Unprocessed/Processed and history visibility. Restore disabled until all verified. Preview shows destination is NEW UNSAVED document, material count/bytes and missing dependencies; confirm/cancel. Failed preview preserves active document. Deferred install shows actual installed document and warning, not generic failure.
ui.history: Hiding recent-history entry never removes retained snapshots. Listing recovery remains possible via project recovery panel even if recent entry hidden. Processed remains restorable; no deletion action.
ui.a11y: Keyboard preview/confirm/cancel; status aria-live; digest/blocked reason accessible; error returns focus without losing draft. No success toast before Ready/install proof.
ui.pagination: max100 entries; server cursor bound to index generation; stale cursor returns changed-index error; no mixed-generation pages.

joint_amendments.M04: capture+recovery ACK+new unsaved restore seams only; no second session, no formal ACK coupling
joint_amendments.M05: new pinned verified byte export +bundle import +recovery proof transfer, explicit material_store Port amendment
joint_amendments.policy: Original pending packets remain unchanged; these coordinated amendments require adoption, not silently granted by M07.

decisions.proposal: Adopt stable capture/SGA-RECOVERY-FP-v1 and exact existing S1 timing/completion mapping, independent baselines.
Adopt self-contained immutable payload+material bundle schema/bounds and new native RecoveryStoragePort.
Adopt pin→objects→index→root-transfer→Published/ACK sequence and explicit uncertain/deferred outcomes.
Adopt restart verification/reconciliation, root retention and no automatic expiration/deletion/repair.
Adopt preview/confirmed new-unsaved restore, M05 verified bundle import and post-install deferred statuses.
Adopt explicit joint M04/M05 capture/pin-export/import/proof amendments; old packets frozen and S1 protected.
Adopt closed UI/ACL/errors/replay, candidate envelope and test/readiness gates.
